description: Call this tool only when the user asks about an AI tool, model, application, architecture, deployment choice, or technology selection. Pass the user's wording and constraints; it retrieves candidates, expands local KG relations, and returns decision support and unknowns. A graph relation is context, not proof. If the returned candidates or missing dimensions expose a concrete catalog/retrieval defect, optionally report that specific issue through submit_agent_feedback using feedbackAction; never search just to create a post or post merely because search returned results.

kind.description: Optional entity type filter, for example tool, model, application, or all. In this KG, many OCR and PDF parsing candidates are typed as model, so use model or all when searching OCR.

language.description: Optional output language override. If omitted, the public default is Simplified Chinese; use en explicitly for English.

query.description: A natural-language business need, constraints, existing offering, tool, model, or concept. Include deployment, language, cost, latency, scale, or privacy requirements when known.

name: search_knowledge_graph

decisionSupport.description: The decision boundary for this query: candidate counts, known criteria, unresolved criteria, and the fact that graph relations are context only.

graph.description: A bounded public KG subgraph containing returned candidate nodes, adjacent context nodes, and typed relations. contextOnly nodes are not recommendations.

retrieval.description: Semantic retrieval diagnostics and the parsed decisionIntent; no private evidence is included.

synthesis.description: Optional second-stage shortlist summary grounded only in the returned KG candidates; absent when the model is unavailable or not needed.

title: Search Zhiyong AI technology decision radar
